trigger: Before starting a software project task that changes workflow assets from a DeepSeek Harness session
When planning, reviewing, or validating project-governance work from a dsh preset session

native_entry.project_instruction_file: AGENTS.md (auto-injected by dsh as workspace instructions)
native_entry.note: dsh has no plugin marketplace and no slash-command surface. The loading model is a generated agent preset whose composition registers the repo skills/ directory plus the adapters/dsh/skill-shims/ command projections as custom skill roots via skill-filesystem.customSkillDirs, so the native skill tool exposes the whole workflow catalog; user gesture /governance loads the governance command shim skill. AGENTS.md is auto-injected into every session whose workspace contains it, and the preset persona carries the Coordinator bootstrap.

ask_user_question.evidence: dsh ships a native ask_user_question tool (dsh-tool-ask-user) with options/multi-select support; used for every interaction boundary in the live session that authored this adapter.

sub_agent.evidence: dsh ships native subagent and subagent_fork tools with in-process spawn and fork providers; children inherit the parent preset composition. The live session that authored this adapter ran three parallel subagents through it.

tool_calling.evidence: dsh ships native pwsh, fs read/write/edit, glob, grep, web_search, background jobs, goal, and todo tools; the live session used all of them while authoring this adapter.

browser.evidence: dsh has web_search but no browser automation tool for page-level validation.
browser.degraded_mode: Mark browser validation blocked or run it from another host adapter.

mcp.evidence: The dsh install ships an MCP client package, but server availability depends on host configuration.
mcp.degraded_mode: Use local scripts and record MCP unavailable when no MCP server is configured.

git_hooks.evidence: Workflow installs and validates pre-commit, commit-msg, and post-commit hooks at the repository level, independent of the agent runtime. The hooks' find_spg_home resolves the workflow home under dsh too: the generated preset directory (copy mode) and the skill-root.txt marker written by launch.py (link mode) are first-class candidates, so installed project hooks self-upgrade after `git pull` + `launch.py --sync`.

workflow_closure.evidence: dsh has native ask_user_question, sub_agent, tool_calling, and git_hooks; the strongest native profile together with Chrys. Only browser automation and MCP remain host-dependent.

runtime_e2e.evidence: This adapter was authored from a live DeepSeek Harness session (dsh --version returns 0.1.0-rc.6) whose workspace is the repository itself. The session loaded the editing-cordis-compositions skill through the native skill tool, ran three parallel subagents through the native subagent tool, used ask_user_question/pwsh/fs/web_search, and mount-validated the generated governance preset through agentPresets.standingKeyFor.

target_cwd_e2e.evidence: Executed from project/e2e-test-project cwd on the local host and returned Test Project status with default-confirm permission mode (same target-cwd fixture every adapter uses).

agent_runtime_e2e.command: dsh session on the governance preset reading .governance/plan-tracker.md from the project cwd
agent_runtime_e2e.evidence: The live dsh session consumed the repository AGENTS.md as auto-injected workspace instructions, loaded governance skills through the native skill tool, and mount-validated the generated preset. E2E_PLATFORM=dsh; E2E_AGENT=Coordinator.
